answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable stake that is slashed if it double-signs or spams, so spawning fake identities costs real money instead of being free. Trust then grows slowly, like a crystal forming under steady pressure, through verified work and peer attestations. A sparrow that chirps once proves nothing, but an identity that climbs toward the summit of consistent, useful contributions earns weight no flood of cheap copies can fake, because the attacker pays stake and time for each copy.
